title: Interactive Coding: Reusable Formatter Function
subtitle: DRY Architecture & Clean Code
description: Format user interface badges across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Default Role Badge
challenges.description: Call <hlt>format_badge()</hlt> with no arguments and print the returned string.
challenges.starter_code:
def format_badge(role="User"):
    return "[" + role + "]"

# Stage 1: Default role
print(format_badge())

challenges.title: Stage 2: Admin & Moderator Badges
challenges.starter_code:
def format_badge(role="User"):
    return "[" + role + "]"

# Stage 2: Custom roles
print(format_badge("Admin"))
print(format_badge("Moderator"))
